description: the spandrel prism of blend/cusp-spandrel-fillet, its line and its arc both filleted at r 0.1 where they meet in a cusp: the line's cylinder stripe and the arc's torus stripe meet on their own section from the top's contact down to the spine one radius below the top, which is cut there; the cusp vertex goes and no face is added (the mutual trim, ADR-0084). Held to a second kernel's record (ADR-0073). Volume is held at 7e-9 (Arris is 6.2e-9 from the second oracle's record), area at 2e-9 (1.8e-9) and inertia at 3e-8 (2.1e-8, on inertia[2][2]), not 1e-9: the torus and the cylinder meet on a section fitted within SECTION_FIT_FRACTION of the linear tolerance (ADR-0042, ADR-0062); the centroid holds at the default

analytic.counts_differ: Open CASCADE adds an eighth face, a B-spline corner patch from the ball at the offsets' meeting to the cusp vertex, which it keeps. The two stripes need none: each is its edge's exact rolling-ball blend, and run on they meet on their own intersection from the top's contact to the spine at the radius below the top, which cuts the spine and removes the cusp vertex (9 / 14 / 7). The second kernel builds exactly that (ADR-0084)
analytic.measure_differs: Open CASCADE's corner patch is an approximation that misses its own neighbours by its tolerance there, so its volume and area differ from the exact mutual trim's beyond its own bound on the patch (ADR-0084 as amended, tools/oracle/cusp_corner_second.py). The second kernel's volume and area, in second_oracle.json, agree with Open CASCADE's common of its own two single-edge fillets to 2.9e-6 of the body at worst, so the record is the exact mutual trim and not a third fit (ADR-0073, ADR-0084). The record is itself a few 1e-9 of the body off the exact mutual trim: a quadrature of the height field min(h1, h2) over the spandrel to 20 digits gives volume 3.41462922637, which Arris's 3.41462922634 matches to 1e-11 and the record's 3.41462920529 misses by 6e-9, so the fixture's tolerances (1e-8 in volume and area, 3e-8 in centroid and inertia) are the record's, not Arris's

occt_step_refused.why: Open CASCADE's corner patch misses its own neighbours by up to its tolerance there (analytic.measure_differs): its own STEP writes the patch's boundary with #428 3.5e-3 off where the faces it meets put it, past the reader's cap of 2.9e-3 for a part this size, and closing it would move geometry. The file describes the oracle's patch, not a solid closed at the reader's tolerances; Arris's own STEP is still read back by Open CASCADE and compared
